user.title: Pair a Wellfed feeder
user.description: Make a member invite on a paired client (`wellfed invite --role member`, or People in the app) and paste it here within 10 minutes. Home Assistant joins as its own client, as a member: it can feed, change the settings, the lock, the plans and the portion weight, and read everything.

data_description.address: The feeder's IP address. Leave empty to find it on the network.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Pair the feeder at {address}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Make a member invite on a paired client (`wellfed invite --role member`, or People in the app) and paste it here within 10 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the feeder again
reauth_confirm.description: The feeder no longer knows this Home Assistant: its key was removed. Make a new member invite on a paired client and paste it here. Home Assistant joins with a new key.

reconfigure.title: Feeder address
reconfigure.description: Where Home Assistant finds the feeder.

data_description.address: The feeder's IP address. Leave empty to find it on the network.

error.invalid_invite: That is not a Wellfed invite.
error.join_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach the feeder, or it did not answer, so nothing was joined. Check the address and that the feeder is on, then try again.
error.join_not_accepted: The feeder did not accept the invite. It may have expired or been used already, so make a new one.
error.join_uncertain: The feeder took the invite, but its answer was lost and Home Assistant could not check whether it joined. Submit again: Home Assistant asks the feeder first, and needs a new invite only if it did not join. If you stop here, a repair names the key so you can remove it.
error.join_failed: Joining the feeder failed. Try again.
error.wrong_feeder: That invite is for a different feeder.
error.not_member_invite: That invite gives more than a member's rights. Home Assistant joins only as a member, so it removed the key it was given. Make a member invite instead.
error.not_member_invite_kept: That invite gives more than a member's rights, and Home Assistant could not remove the key it was given. Remove the client named home-assistant from the feeder (People in the app, or `wellfed revoke`), then make a member invite.

abort.not_a_feeder: That device does not look like a Wellfed feeder.
abort.pair_again: This entry is from an earlier test build, or reached the feeder through a Wellfed server, which Wellfed no longer supports. Delete it and add the feeder again with a member invite.

cancel_feed.description: Stop a running feed. Without a number, the feed Home Assistant started.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: The feeder's number for the feed.

write_uncertain.message: The feeder did not answer, so it may have run. It was not sent again: the feeding history will show whether it did.

not_a_feeder.message: That device is not a Wellfed feeder.

no_feed.message: No feed from Home Assistant is running to cancel.

revoked.message: The feeder no longer knows this Home Assistant. Pair it again.

not_ready.message: The feeder did not answer. Home Assistant will try again.

not_sent_disconnected.message: Not sent: the feeder is not connected. Nothing reached it, so you can try again.

not_sent_stopped.message: Not sent: this feeder's session has stopped. Reload the integration, or pair it again if it was removed.

not_sent_busy.message: Not sent: a change to the same settings is still waiting on the feeder. Try again in a moment.

not_sent_forbidden.message: Not sent: this client's role may not do that.

not_sent_unsupported.message: Not sent: the feeder's firmware does not support this.

not_sent_not_read.message: Not sent: Home Assistant has not read the feeder's settings yet. Try again in a moment.

not_sent_invalid.message: Not sent: that value is outside what the feeder accepts.

not_sent_held.message: Not sent: another feed is still being answered, a feed whose answer was lost may have run, or Home Assistant could not read its records. No feed goes until that is settled or you allow feeding again from its repair. Check the bowl first.

refused_forbidden.message: The feeder refused: this client's role may not do that.

refused_stale.message: The feeder refused: the settings changed meanwhile. Home Assistant read them again; check and try again.

refused_busy.message: The feeder refused: it is busy. Try again in a moment.

refused_unavailable.message: The feeder refused: this firmware does not serve that.

refused_invalid.message: The feeder refused: a value failed its checks.

refused_not_writable.message: The feeder refused: its storage cannot be written now.

refused_full.message: The feeder refused: it is full.

refused_not_found.message: The feeder refused: there is no such feed or plan.

refused_muted.message: The feeder refused: its sound is off or outside its sound window.

refused_fault.message: The feeder refused: it stopped on a fault and feeds again after a restart.

refused_unverified.message: The feeder refused: that bowl mode is not verified on this feeder.

refused_portions.message: The feeder refused: a feed is 1 to 48 portions.

refused_no_clock.message: The feeder refused: its clock is not set yet.

refused_newer_build.message: The feeder refused it for a reason this integration does not know, from a newer feeder build. Update the integration to see why.

bad_entry.message: This entry's settings are not valid. Remove it and add the feeder again.

not_sent_not_saved.message: Not sent: Home Assistant could not save the feed's record first, so it could not hold the next feed on it if it stopped before the answer. Check the log for why the store could not be written.

not_sent_legacy.message: Not sent: the feeder runs firmware from before this integration's device API. Update it from the Wellfed app.

no_client_key.message: This entry reached the feeder through a Wellfed server, which Wellfed no longer supports. Delete it and add the feeder directly, with a member invite.

uncertain_feed.title: A feed on feeder {feeder} may have run
uncertain_feed.description: Home Assistant sent a feed and no answer came, so it may have run. It was not sent again, and Home Assistant sends no other feed until it is settled. This clears itself once the feed's record turns up. Check the bowl.

unknown_feed.title: Feeding from Home Assistant is paused on feeder {feeder}

confirm.title: Allow feeding again on feeder {feeder}
confirm.description:
Home Assistant sent a feed of {portions} portions and no answer came, and no record of it has turned up, in the feeder's history. It may have run without being recorded, or never reached the feeder. So that the bowl is not filled twice, Home Assistant sends no other feed until that feed's record turns up, which clears this by itself.

Check the bowl first. Submitting allows feeding from Home Assistant again even though that feed may have run. If its record turns up within a week, Home Assistant still logs how it ended. Deleting this feeder's Wellfed entry also drops the hold.

abort.not_loaded: This feeder's Wellfed entry is not loaded. Try again once it is set up.

store_unread.title: Feeding from Home Assistant is paused on feeder {feeder}

confirm.title: Allow feeding again on feeder {feeder}
confirm.description:
Home Assistant could not read what it had kept about feeder {feeder}, which may have included a feed whose answer was lost and that may have run. So that the bowl is not filled twice, Home Assistant sends no feed until you say the bowl is checked.

Check the bowl first. Submitting allows feeding from Home Assistant again. Deleting this feeder's Wellfed entry also drops the hold.

abort.not_loaded: This feeder's Wellfed entry is not loaded. Try again once it is set up.

store_read_only.title: Feeding from Home Assistant is stopped on feeder {feeder}
store_read_only.description:
Home Assistant cannot save what it keeps about feeder {feeder}: its store, {path}, was written by a newer version of this integration, or is not in the shape this version writes and could not be moved aside. It is left as it is, and since no feed could be kept across a restart, Home Assistant sends no feed. Checking the bowl does not change that.

Update the integration to the version that wrote the store. Or, to start this feeder's store afresh, stop Home Assistant, remove that file, and start it again; check the bowl before feeding, since a feed it held may have run.

hold_dropped.title: Check the bowl of feeder {feeder} before feeding
hold_dropped.description: A Wellfed entry for feeder {feeder} was deleted while Home Assistant held its feeds back after a feed that may have run, or after its records could not be read. The hold went with the entry, so a new entry for the feeder feeds at once. Check the bowl before feeding, then ignore this.

update_feeder.title: Feeder {feeder} runs older firmware
update_feeder.description: Feeder {feeder} runs build {build}, older than this integration expects. Everything both know works; what the feeder lacks is refused. Update the feeder from the Wellfed app. This clears once it runs a newer build.

update_integration.title: Update the Wellfed integration for feeder {feeder}
update_integration.description: Feeder {feeder} runs build {build}, newer than this integration. Everything both know works; what the newer build added shows as unknown. Update the Wellfed integration. This clears once it matches.

time_server_disagrees.title: Feeder {feeder}'s time server disagrees with its clock
time_server_disagrees.description: Feeder {feeder} lost its clock, and its time server answers with a time far from the one it last trusted. One of them is wrong, so neither Home Assistant nor any phone sets the clock by itself, and scheduled meals wait. Left alone, the feeder can take hours or days to accept the server, the longer the further apart they are. Ask an owner to open Clock in the Wellfed app and check the time source under Get the time from, or choose another, or to set the time from their phone if its time is right. This clears once the clock is set.

legacy_feeder.title: Feeder {feeder} needs a firmware update
legacy_feeder.description: Feeder {feeder} runs build {build}, from before this integration's device API, so Home Assistant can read and change nothing on it and its entities are unavailable. Update the feeder from the Wellfed app. Home Assistant tries again on its own, and this clears once it answers.

leftover_key_unjoined.title: Remove a key Home Assistant may have added to feeder {feeder}
leftover_key_unjoined.description: Setting up feeder {feeder} stopped after a join whose answer was lost, so the feeder may list the key Home Assistant tried to add (it starts {key}). If it does, remove the client named home-assistant whose key starts {key}, in the feeder's people in the app or with `wellfed revoke {key}`, then ignore this.
